title: The initial sort is Days Open with the longest-open work order first
preconds:
1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
  2. A tab shows several work orders created on different dates.
steps:
1. Open the Work In Progress report without clicking any column header.
  2. Read the Days Open values from the top row down.
expected:
1. The rows are sorted by Days Open, longest-open first (descending).
